quick_skim.title: AlignMorph: Tuning-Free Diffusion Image Morphing via Explicit Semantic Transport
quick_skim.abstract: Image morphing aims to produce a smooth and semantically consistent transition between two input images. Existing diffusion-based morphing methods either require expensive per-pair optimization or rely on implicit spatial alignment, which easily fails under large layout discrepancies. To address these limitations, we propose AlignMorph, a novel tuning-free diffusion framework guided by the principle of transport-then-denoise. We explicitly decouple geometric alignment from generative denoising to avoid structural entanglement. Our framework consists of two core components. (1) Global Semantic Transport, which achieves diffusion-compatible semantic alignment via entropic optimal transport and reliability-aware latent warping; and (2) Coordinate-Aligned Generation, which uses a symmetric bi-phase attention handoff to maintain consistent spatial coordinates throughout denoising. Without any tuning, AlignMorph effectively eliminates ghosting and achieves superior structural coherence and temporal smoothness on morphing benchmarks. Code is available at https://github.com/51xOne/Alignmorph.

quick_skim.llm_tldr_en: AlignMorph is a tuning-free diffusion morphing framework that uses entropic optimal transport for global semantic alignment and decouples geometry from denoising.
quick_skim.llm_tldr_cn: 针对扩散图像变形方法依赖逐对优化或隐式对齐、在大布局差异下易失败的问题，作者提出免调优框架AlignMorph。其遵循先传输后去噪原则，用熵最优传输完成全局语义传输，并进行可靠性感知的隐空间变形。该方法显式解耦几何对齐与生成去噪，从而避免结构纠缠。实验表明其能在无需调优的情况下产生平滑且语义一致的变形，提升了大差异场景下的鲁棒性。
